visuals.summary: Caption 'Figure 1 : Our Work'. A dashed frame titled 'Trading strategies based on optimized voting systems' holds six dashed boxes. 'Solution Optimality Analysis' lists the scientific nature of indicator selection and revision, optimal parameter rationality, and comparative revenue analysis. 'Price Forecasting Model' lists training neural network models and forecasting future prices. 'Investment decision factor' lists introduction of decision factors, optimization of decision factor parameters, and picking a combination of bitcoin gold decision factors. 'Transaction cost sensitivity' lists sensitivity of decision factors and optimize voting system sensitivity. 'Voting System' lists creating a factor voting system and the analyzer determines the action strategy. A hexagon 'The optimization model' feeds three boxes each labeled 'Run trading models', which feed 'Compare the impact of transaction costs' and 'Comparison of model optimization results'. Outside the frame, a data icon lists BCHAIN-MKPRU.csv and LBMA-GOLD.csv, then 'Data pre-processing/integration', 'Create dataset', and 'Separate the training data set'.
